newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO REVERSES GAINS, DLR PUTS EXERCISED.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO REVERSES GAINS, DLR PUTS EXERCISED.

text.p: The Mexican peso reversed initial gains and was down across the board in late morning dealing on Thursday.
Dealers said many players had to cover short dollar positions after dollar put options they exercised on Tuesday had fallen due.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were weaker, respectively, at 7.8075/7.8150 and 7.8055/7.8130 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade 0.8 centavo weaker at 7.7770/7.7820 per dollar.
